descriptionPlain: We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to accelerate our product roadmap.

lists.content:
• Architect resilient client-side web applications using React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
  • Build robust GraphQL and REST API endpoints in Node.js and PostgreSQL.

• 5+ years of software development experience with modern web stacks.
  • Deep proficiency in React, TypeScript, and state management.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of relational database schema design.

• Experience with AWS ECS and Terraform infrastructure as code.
  • Familiarity with Tailwind CSS and accessible design systems.
